title: Ethos: Rectifying Language Models in Orthogonal Parameter Space
findings: The proposed 'Ethos' method was effective at debiasing models for the religion attribute. On the GPT2-1.5B model, Ethos achieved the highest Idealized Context Association Test (ICAT) score (73.25) for religion compared to the pre-trained model (65.48) and other baseline methods, indicating a better trade-off between reducing stereotypes and preserving language modeling quality.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured stereotypical associations related to religion using the StereoSet dataset. Specifically, it evaluated the model's preference for stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentences (Stereotype Score - SS) and its language modeling capabilities in these contexts (Language Modeling Score - LMS, and Idealized Context Association Test - ICAT).
